campbell.title: Campbell City Council — October 6, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council's agenda for this meeting listed discussion of temporary legal services during the city attorney transition, along with compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees. The agenda also listed a proposed market adjustment to the city manager's salary.
keyTopics: Temporary legal services during the city attorney transition
Compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees
Market adjustment to the city manager's salary

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — October 21, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's October 21, 2026, agenda listed routine business alongside several land-use and policy items. These included final map approvals for lot splits on Farwell Avenue and Sobey Road, an annual update to city code provisions, and a proposal to create a task force exploring a Climate Resilience District.
keyTopics: Final map approval for a two-lot split at 14860 Farwell Ave
Final map approval for a two-lot split at 18510 Sobey Rd
Annual code update covering appeal scheduling and City Commissioner qualifications
Resolutions to establish a Climate Resilience District Task Force and begin the process of forming a Climate Resilience District
Approval of minutes from the September 30 and October 7, 2026, meetings, and accounts payable check registers

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — October 13, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council agenda for October 13, 2026, includes routine financial and administrative items, along with resolutions on a residential electrification rebate program and Below Market Rate housing guidelines. The agenda also lists a review of the Commission and Committee Handbook, an update on Ada's Cafe at the Community Center, and the tentative council calendar and Housing Element implementation schedule.
keyTopics: Resolution to appropriate $78,000 for a residential electrification rebate program
Resolution approving Below Market Rate (BMR) For-Sale and Rental Housing Guidelines
Resolutions accepting completion of sanitary sewer spot repair/CCTV inspection work and the FY2024-25 Annual Streets Project
Update on the Conflict of Interest Code for staff and commissioners
Review of the Commission and Committee Handbook

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — October 20, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council's October 20, 2026, agenda listed routine business, including approval of minutes from two early-October meetings and standard financial reports. It also included items authorizing the Town Manager to execute or negotiate agreements, such as an amendment with Foster and Foster, a new three-year agreement, and a lease amendment.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the October 6, 2026, Special and regular Town Council meetings
Review of the August 2026 Expenditure, Revenue, and Monthly Financial/Investment Reports
Approval and ratification of Accounts Payable Check Registers and Payroll Report
Authorization for a First Amendment with Foster and Foster
Authorization for a three-year agreement and a lease amendment negotiation

san-jose.title: San José City Council — October 20, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José City Council's agenda for this meeting lists routine business such as approving minutes, excused absences, and special-event funding, alongside several significant land-use and policy items. These include a hearing on vacating a portion of Spring Street, the 2025 Independent Police Auditor's year-end report, a citywide planning work plan discussion, and multiple development-related appeals and a general plan amendment request. The agenda also includes a report from the City Manager and a Civil Service Commission interview.
keyTopics: Administrative hearing on an appeal of a site development permit and environmental decision at 470 West San Carlos Street
Administrative hearing on an appeal of an in-fill exemption for a proposed data center at 300 Holger Way
Early consideration of a privately initiated General Plan Amendment for property at 525 Race Street
2025 Independent Police Auditor Year End Report
Proposed conditional vacation of a portion of Spring Street between Asbury Street and West Taylor Street

mountain-view.title: Mountain View City Council — October 20, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View City Council's agenda for this date lists a 6:30 p.m. study session focused on candidate interviews for appointment to the Environmental Planning Commission. The agenda also includes standard legal and procedural notices about public comment, accessibility, and challenging City decisions.
keyTopics: Study session: Council interviews of applicants for the Environmental Planning Commission

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — October 6, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council's October 6, 2026, agenda includes several routine approvals, recognitions (including local Little League all-stars, Indigenous Peoples' Day, and Friends of the Library Week), and consent items such as a consultant contract amendment and a salary adjustment for a Public Safety Communications Manager. The agenda also lists two notable public hearings/business items: an ordinance to restrict irrigation of nonfunctional turf with potable water, and a proposed Service Worker Retention Ordinance, along with approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation.
keyTopics: Ordinance to prohibit potable water use for irrigating nonfunctional turf, per state law AB 1572
Introduction of a Service Worker Retention Ordinance
Public art approval for the Lakewood Park renovation
Purchase agreement amendment with WSP USA for environmental consulting at the SMaRT Station and Sunnyvale Landfill
Salary resolution amendment for the Public Safety Communications Manager classification

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — October 20, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council's October 20, 2026, agenda includes a proposal for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard, several ceremonial recognitions, and a routine consent calendar covering contracts, minutes, and grant funding. The agenda also lists a public hearing on conduit financing for an apartment project and consideration of an amendment to the City Manager's employment agreement.
keyTopics: Proposed approach for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard
Resolution to accept $850,000 in federal grant funds and award a design services contract for the McClellan Road Bridge Project
Contract award to Bay Aerials Gymnastics for gymnastics classes and camps, with an option to extend to a five-year, $800,000 total
TEFRA public hearing and approval of conduit financing for The RISE Block 5 Apartments project
First Amendment to the City Manager Employment Agreement with Tina Kapoor and changes to appointed employees' compensation program

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara Neighborhood-University Relations Committee — October 19, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This is the published agenda for a Special Meeting of Santa Clara's Neighborhood University Relations Committee, which covers city-university relations near Santa Clara University. The agenda lists approval of past meeting minutes, a 2027 meeting calendar, a discussion on neighborhood nuisance issues tied to private property leases in the Old Quad neighborhood, and updates from several city and university departments. Residents can attend in person or via Zoom, and written comments could be submitted ahead of the meeting.
keyTopics: Discussion of neighborhood nuisance issues in private property leases in the Old Quad neighborhood, with possible direction to staff on communicating the Committee's input to property owners
Approval of the May 18, 2026, meeting minutes
Adoption of the 2027 Committee meeting calendar
Updates from the Community Development Department, Santa Clara University, and the Police Department

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — October 20, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council agenda for October 20, 2026, lists routine items alongside proposals to rename the Cesar Chavez Community Garden and Plaza and to name a new community garden at Delano Manongs Park after Larry Itliong. The agenda also includes a contract amendment for design work on the Metro Tango Subdistrict Park project, a presentation from the Santa Clara County Mosquito and Vector Control District, and review of annual reports and work plans for eight city commissions.
keyTopics: Proposed renaming of Cesar Chavez Community Garden to 'Milpitas Community Garden' and Cesar Chavez Plaza to 'Milpitas Civic Center Plaza,' plus naming a new 'Larry Itliong Community Garden' at Delano Manongs Park
Proposed Amendment No. 2 to the design services agreement with Callander Associates Landscape Architecture for the Metro Tango Subdistrict Park Project, not to exceed $130,000
Presentation from the Santa Clara County Mosquito and Vector Control District

FY2025-26 Annual Report and proposed FY2026-27 work plans for eight city commissions, including Arts, Economic Development and Trade, Library and Education Advisory, and Parks, Recreation and Cultural Resources Commissions
Approval of October 6, 2026, City Council meeting minutes and the council calendar for October and November 2026

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Architectural Review Board — October 15, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Architectural Review Board agenda for October 15, 2026, lists a public hearing on an AT&T application to add wireless equipment to existing city-owned wood utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue. The request covers two wireless facilities, including new antennas, radio equipment, and seven-foot pole extensions, and the agenda marks it as exempt from further environmental review under CEQA.
keyTopics: AT&T request to collocate antennas, remote radio units, and 7-foot fiberglass pole extensions on existing utility poles near 670 Guinda Street and 754 Homer Avenue
Two Tier 2 General Wireless Communication Facility applications under review
Project located in the public right-of-way rather than a standard zoning district
CEQA exemption cited under Guideline Section 15301 (Existing Facilities)
